resampling: all 215 whole subjects; logical PCG64 streams SHA256(master|stage|replicate); same multiplicity for all statistics in a stage replicate

symptoms.estimand: proportion listing a code among people with a recorded relevant field; symptom-region pairs among both fields recorded
symptoms.code_absent_from_recorded_set: not listed; not a clinical absence assertion
symptoms.missing_field: unrecorded; excluded from that field denominator, never recoded as clinical negative
symptoms.include: all 12 symptoms, 9 regions, 108 symptom-region pairs including zero counts, 10 legacy rule patterns
symptoms.rule_patterns: reviewed static logical matching only; no duration/clinical diagnosis assertion
symptoms.unknown_code_policy: reject before inference; no silent removal

finite_changes.support: all h+1 actual consecutive numeric minutes t..t+h required
finite_changes.estimand: change among subjects actually observed throughout each specified interval; each t,h has its own support
finite_changes.rate: change/h, signed VAS units per minute; never instantaneous derivative
finite_changes.median: generalized inverse empirical CDF, ceil(n*.5); same rule in bootstrap
finite_changes.positive_negative_zero: exact comparison of observed arithmetic changes; no clinical threshold
finite_changes.zero_support: undefined and retained, never bridged or substituted

MC.targets: both relative and absolute must be met
MC.family: all frozen statistics in each stage times two endpoints
MC.checkpoint: single final fixed 200000; no automatic extension, no pilot pooling
MC.quantile: ceil(Bp) generalized inverse with exact binomial ranks and sentinel bounds
MC.undefined: retain attempted/valid/undefined; success-conditional descriptive range; not calibrated population CI

prediction_summary.verify: all 200 fold payloads, whole-person outer/inner partitions, OOF row coverage, targets and persistence predictions
prediction_summary.weights: original next-rating primary window-equal plus person-equal sensitivity; five-to-ten person-equal
prediction_summary.repeat_ranges: median/min/max across all 20; partition/training sensitivity, not CI or external validation
